title: WaveBeginRequest
description: The choice the owner took on the wave's start card, and the wave's slices.

choice.description: build goes on to build the slices; build-over does too, and each slice's attempt and the step combine drop the branches an earlier run left; stop ends the run before anything is cut.

slices.description: The wave's slices, whose kept tests are forgotten if the run fails after this step.
